title: Final Surface Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct equation of the reflecting surface as z = (omega^2 * r^2) / (2 * g).

title: Final Angular Velocity
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the required angular velocity as omega = 7 rad/s.

title: Integration Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student should show the correct integration process leading to the surface equation.

title: Use of Dynamics
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the principles of dynamics to derive the relationship between forces and angular velocity.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Case Consideration
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss the limiting case of r being much smaller than R.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factor placement in equations.
